item.title: Rotary Club of Gainesville names 2026 Man of the Year
item.description: The Rotary Club of Gainesville named a pair of local business and community leaders its Gainesville/Hall County Man and Woman of the Year on Monday night.

item.description: The Rotary Club of Gainesville named a pair of local business and community leaders its Gainesville/Hall County Man and Woman of the Year on Monday night.

item.title: Gainesville man charged with critically injuring roommate in fight
item.description: A Gainesville man has been arrested after authorities say a fight with his roommate Friday night left the other man hospitalized with a brain bleed and a broken jaw.

item.title: Hall County restaurant inspections: El Sombrero, Tupelo Honey, Gainesville Middle School and others for Feb. 3-9
item.description: The following are among the food service establishments inspected by the Hall County Environmental Health Department.

item.title: Legislation to insulate consumers from data center electricity costs passes House committee
item.description: With affordability a top concern of voters, Georgia lawmakers are moving to insulate electricity ratepayers from costs driven by demand from power-guzzling data centers.

item.title: Update: Fire breaks out outside Gainesville Civic Center; cause under investigation
item.description: A fire occurred in the trash bin outside the Gainesville Civic Center Tuesday, Feb. 10, according to Gainesville Fire Chief Brandon Ellis.

item.title: What U.S. Rep. Andrew Clyde has said about ICE plans for ‘small processing facility’ in Oakwood
item.description: Oakwood city officials have said they have confirmed the location of the facility will be in the Alliance 985 Business Park at 3619 Atlanta Highway.

item.title: Flowery Branch man charged with murdering brother at parents’ home
item.description: A Flowery Branch man has been charged with shooting and killing his brother Monday night at their parents’ home, the Hall County Sheriff’s Office said.

item.title: More than $14 million in renovations approved at these Hall County Schools
item.description: The Hall County School Board approved more than $14 million to fund construction and renovations for six Hall County Schools on Monday, Feb. 9.

item.title: Cleveland man pleads guilty to shooting at deputies after I-985 traffic stop
item.description: A 28-year-old Cleveland man charged with shooting at deputies during a high-speed chase last year took a plea deal Monday, Feb. 9, according to the District Attorney’s Office.
